text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Urk… I feel like my body fat percentage's gone up a lot.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Well, you have been snacking in your room after getting back from your part-time jobs, Ines.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But I can't help getting hungry when I handle food at work…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. I know how that feels, but don't forget to work up a sweat after you chow down.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: By the way, Ryan, what's your body fat percentage?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You wanna see? I'll measure myself right now.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That's a crazy number. You're pure muscle…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Okay, that's it! I'm going to get fit!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hey, I can help you out with that! Let's start with a hundred squats!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …No, if I want to bulk up, then a workout like that is just what I need!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Ryan! I'm going to tone up for sure!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Mejiro Ryan's help, Ines Fujin maintains a healthy physique.
